card.title: Try It First
card.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

mechanism: A persuades B to test a cheap drink substitute before risking their own breakfast cup.
confusable: Unlike sharing a new drink, A must condition their own use on B's test result.
comparison: D32-b prices the test with a croissant; D32-a equips B for a possible spray rather than turns the tap themself.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
